title: RX-V2: bbox_refactor_run cargo-only command allowlist for atom dispatches
content: For `bbox_refactor_run` invocations dispatched from atomic refactor agents (design/refactor-agents.md), command steps are restricted to a narrow cargo allowlist: `cargo check` (any args, including --message-format=json and feature flags), `cargo test` (any args), `cargo clippy` (any args), `cargo fmt` only when `touches` is explicitly declared, `cargo build` (allowed but typically wasteful). Any other command in an atom-dispatched run is a prompt-discipline violation; the atom should refuse to compose it. v1 enforcement is via atom prompt templates + brofile Bash/Write/Edit denial. v2 path: runner inspects `dispatch_origin` flag (set by bro_agent_dispatch) and enforces server-side. Mutating commands not in the allowlist must declare `touches` so the runner can snapshot/rollback; an atom-dispatched run with an undeclared-touches mutating command is unsupported.
